products.name: MSME Ops Desk Lite
products.pricing_status: NO_PAID_LAUNCH; free calculators and invoice trackers saturate generic feature set
products.differentiation: Offline-first no-account utility, but margin, cash runway, reorder, receivables and sales-log features overlap free calculators and trackers; differentiation and buyer demand unproven.
products.next_action: Freeze feature development. Retain as optional free sample/lead magnet only after a real audience and distribution path are evidenced.

products.name: Recruitment Agency Revenue Assurance Desk
products.distribution: Getvik Free primary validation rail; Topmate secondary; Payhip+Razorpay backup; none activated
products.pricing_status: UNVALIDATED_HYPOTHESES_499_799_999; no buyer willingness-to-pay evidence; Getvik Free 10% + GST on fee + Cashfree gateway charges
products.differentiation: Narrow offline, no-account financial-control layer beside an existing ATS: installment receipts, cash-collected commission payable, due-date ageing, late-payment detection, payment-linked guarantee risk flags and guarantee event log; no candidate PII. Differentiation versus free finance dashboards and ATS suites remains weak/unproven and must be validated.
products.next_action: HOLD further product development and publication. Run a no-publication demand experiment with 5–8 small recruitment agency owners; test whether offline/no-candidate-PII and cash-basis commission/guarantee controls solve a problem not adequately served by free/low-cost alternatives. No willingness-to-pay claims until observed.
products.market_evidence: Phase 42 competitor audit: MoneyGence offers recruitment-agency client finance, invoices, collections and receivables with first 2 clients free; IT Ways, WePlacement and HireXL offer placement billing, commission/replacement tracking and related ATS features. Product is not differentiated enough on feature count; offline/no-candidate-PII narrow positioning is only a hypothesis.
